scope: CPU/static feasibility diagnostic only for the root-selected explicit non-occluding crossing grammar. The diagnostic must first prove that every frozen repair region has exactly one strict, interior, nonparallel, source-provenanced actual-segment by predicted dash-on intersection. It may emit hypothetical bracket topology only as diagnostic data; it does not authorize product geometry, rendering, CMake, GPU, readiness, capture, machine, or TA acceptance.

root_product_decision_binding.selection_statement: ROOT PRODUCT DECISION: SELECTED EXPLICIT_NON_OCCLUDING_CROSSING_GRAMMAR from Phase4 V17 product-decision gate SHA c08b7f2c15fa9f53c0ecc76c7c44f07265500b520dfa377097568296d56d8329.

descriptor_source_contract.ledger_limitation: The frozen V15 sample ledger records pixels, primitive IDs, arc IDs, fragment class and dash-local t, but not both analytic segment endpoints. It cannot alone prove a strict nonparallel interior intersection.
descriptor_source_contract.authorized_reconstruction: A standalone CPU diagnostic may compile the exact frozen trajectory renderer and frozen replay dependencies read-only, build the broadcast draw package, and extract projected actual centerline segment plus predicted dash-on interior descriptors before rasterization. No production or CMake edit is allowed.

strict_intersection_predicate.actual_operand: One projected ActualRouteBodyCore centerline segment interior with exact existing arc and primitive provenance.
strict_intersection_predicate.predicted_operand: One projected predicted dash base-body centerline strictly inside its dash-on interval; cap extension, dash-gap intrusion, inner/outer halo, endpoint and marker are excluded.
strict_intersection_predicate.nonparallel_rule: Use a robust orientation/determinant predicate with an explicit numerical error bound. A determinant whose sign is not provable is ambiguous and fails closed; no tunable angle threshold is permitted.
strict_intersection_predicate.strict_interior_rule: Both segment parameters must be provably strictly inside their open intervals. Endpoint, tangent touch, shared vertex, cap-only contact and interval-boundary contact fail closed.
strict_intersection_predicate.unique_event_key: ordered(existing actual source ID, actual arc+stem, existing predicted source ID, predicted arc+normalized stem, analytic route-order interval)
strict_intersection_predicate.deduplication: Multiple covered pixels or MSAA samples from one analytic intersection collapse to one event; different source pairs never merge.
explicit_infeasible_classes: zero qualifying intersection in any repair region
more than one qualifying intersection in any repair region
predicted dash gap, cap extension, halo, endpoint, marker or outer-rim contact
foreign, double, unowned, missing or color-derived provenance

repair_region_matching_boundary.post_generation_audit_only: After the complete event inventory is frozen, an audit matcher may ask which event covers each output-only repair probe region. These coordinates and repair IDs may not influence descriptor generation, intersection classification, deduplication, or glyph topology.
repair_region_matching_boundary.per_case_acceptance: Exactly one qualifying event covers each of the three repair regions for both palettes and all three sample profiles, with the identical ordered source-provenance event key.

diagnostic_only_bracket_topology.purpose: Prove geometric feasibility only; the bracket is not product geometry and may not be consumed by the renderer.
diagnostic_only_bracket_topology.shape: Paired bridge/underpass bracket halves outside the complete predicted core plus inner and outer silhouette, joined by route-graph semantics rather than color.
diagnostic_only_bracket_topology.emission_order_model: Hypothetically after the frozen predicted silhouette without erasing, recoloring or suppressing any baseline fragment.
diagnostic_only_bracket_topology.source_identity_model: Each half aliases the existing actual core/halo ownership token and records the paired existing predicted source key in diagnostic metadata. No new semantic batch, token, source probe, primitive ID or arc ID is created.
required_cpu_checks: paired halves are separate from and do not overwrite the complete protected predicted silhouette at every covered sample
actual and predicted route graphs are both traceable through the event; removing either half fails the actual-route traceability fixture
standard, CVD and grayscale topology are identical
1x, asymmetric 2x and asymmetric 4x any-sample coverage preserve the same analytic event key
original actual/predicted masks, exact 81 source order/digest and three repair IDs remain byte-identical

required_fail_closed_fixtures: inner/outer halo, endpoint, tick and marker negative
foreign, double, unowned and missing-provenance negative
duplicate raster samples collapse without duplicate events
zero and multiple events per repair region force overall infeasible
repair coordinate, capture, camera, palette and repair-ID mutation cannot alter generated event inventory
forbidden: No production source, header, CMake, shipping flag, shader, pass, texture, camera, replay, UI, asset, authority or product-exposure edit.
No coordinate, repair-ID, capture-ID, camera-name, palette-color or pass-result input to descriptor generation or intersection selection.
No acceptance-threshold, largest8, contrast, visible-region, source-count, ownership or telemetry-semantic change.
No protected predicted discard, global actual priority, erasure, recolor, z-order-only, whole-route offset or extra product pass.
No claim that diagnostic bracket topology is implemented, visually accepted, understood by humans, GPU-ready, machine-passing, golden, beta or product-passing.
